description: Check which reporter/period/classification combinations have published data before constructing expensive trade queries. Returns dataset records with period, classification, record count, and first/latest release dates. Call this before querying recent periods — annual data is typically published 3–12 months after the reference year and not all countries report every year. Omit filters to browse the availability index, 50 rows by default. Continue with nextOffset using the same filters and limit.

classification.description: Classification code filter (e.g. "HS", "H6", "EB10"). Omitted or blank defaults to HS for goods and EB10 for services.

freq.description: Frequency: A=annual YYYY, M=monthly YYYYMM (01–12). Omit to infer it from period, or annual when period is omitted too; an explicit value must match period.

limit.description: Maximum datasets returned per page; defaults to 50.

offset.description: Number of matching datasets to skip; use nextOffset to continue.

period.description: Period to check: YYYY (annual) or YYYYMM (monthly). Omit to see all available periods for the reporter.

reporter_code.description: M49 reporter code to check. Omit to browse availability across all reporters.

name: comtrade_get_data_availability

firstReleased.description: First release timestamp supplied by UN Comtrade.

lastReleased.description: Latest release or revision timestamp supplied by UN Comtrade.

totalRecords.description: Number of records available in this dataset.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the availability query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns malformed availability data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page; absent when no rows remain.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no availability records are found.

offset.description: Number of matching datasets skipped for this page.

shown.description: Number of datasets returned on this page.

totalDatasets.description: Total number of available dataset records.

truncated.description: Whether this page contains only part of the matching dataset list.

title: Check Data Availability
